name: s45CloseSupervision
note: Cutting with children has no set number, only close supervision, November 5, 2026

changes.from: - One adult works with no more than two children cutting at once, while the others wash, tear, scoop or watch, then they trade.
changes.to: - An adult stays close beside each child who is cutting (close supervision), while the others wash, tear, scoop or watch.
